items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers listed as doubtful for Sunday vs. Saints due to hamstring.
items.why: Missed consecutive practices with hamstring after exiting Week 1 early; second straight DNP Thursday.
items.implication: Unlikely to play; fade Flowers in lineups pending final inactive.
items.opportunity: Increased target share for remaining Ravens WRs with Ja'Kobi Lane already on IR/return.

items.text: Raiders listing TE Brock Bowers as doubtful for Sunday vs. Chargers due to knee injury, per HC Klint Kubiak.
items.why: Knee injury; did not practice fully leading into Friday designation.
items.implication: High risk of inactive; avoid in DFS/season starts.
items.opportunity: Backup TE usage spike if OUT.

items.text: Chargers listing WR Ladd McConkey as questionable for Sunday vs. Raiders due to rib injury; he did practice Friday.
items.why: Rib injury from Week 1; practiced Friday after earlier limited/DNP concerns.
items.implication: Game-time lean possible; monitor inactives closely for start/sit.
items.opportunity: If limited/OUT, Quentin Johnston and Tre Harris see major route/target spikes (both 90%+ without him in Week 1).

items.text: Bengals listing QB Joe Burrow, who said he would play, as questionable for Sunday at Houston due to back injury.
items.why: Back injury; self-reported intent to play but official Q designation.
items.implication: Likely plays but monitor for any setback; full value if active.

items.text: Vikings ruled out QB Kyler Murray (concussion); Carson Wentz starts vs Bears. Jefferson already saw 37% target share from Wentz in Week 1 with strong historical production together.
items.implication: Jefferson remains elite start with proven Wentz chemistry.
items.opportunity: Sustained high target share for Jefferson.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson says 'I'm ready to go.' Still unclear how much he earns vs Rhamondre Stevenson, but returning at right time: Pats desperate for explosives with AJ Brown on IR, plus strong upcoming matchups (PIT/JAX/BUF/LV/NYJ/CHI/MIA/GB/DET) before Week 11 bye.
items.why: Player statement + timing with AJ Brown IR and schedule strength; explosive need in offense.
items.implication: Henderson viable flex/RB2 upside in favorable stretch; Stevenson handcuff/committee risk.
items.opportunity: Potential snap/carry/route expansion in committee; Brown absence opens more passing-game involvement for backs/WRs.

items.text: If Zay Flowers (hamstring, consecutive DNPs) can't go, Ravens WRs hierarchy: 1. Rashod Bateman 2. Devontez Walker 3. LaJohntay Wester 4. Elijah Sarratt 5. Chris Moore. Ja'Kobi Lane already on IR/return with fractured wrist.
items.why: Practice absences + existing Lane IR create clear depth chart elevation.
items.implication: Bateman primary add/start if Flowers OUT; deeper options speculative.
items.opportunity: Target/route share redistribution among remaining WRs; Andrews also elevated per other notes.

items.text: Nico Collins hamstring (Wednesday practice, history of 5-game miss in 2024); MRI key. Week 1 routes on 42 Stroud dropbacks: Collins 37, Hutchinson 29, Boutte 27, Noel 15, Wayne 8. Status in jeopardy pre-OUT ruling.
items.why: Dominant prior usage + injury history raises multi-week concern even if short-term.
items.implication: Clear hierarchy for volume if multi-week; immediate waiver on Hutchinson/Boutte/Noel/Schultz.
items.opportunity: Massive snap/route vacuum filled by next men up.

items.text: Kenneth Walker LOVE Week 2 vs IND: handled 21/24 RB touches through 3Q (74% snaps), 40% routes targeted (team lead tie), 24% target share (2nd-highest career). IND allowed 163 yards/3 TDs to Henry. RB1 overall in range of outcomes if healthy.
items.why: Elite Week 1 utilization + soft matchup + receiving involvement.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty LOVE @ LAC: Week 1 Utilization Score 99 (tied Bijan for lead). 19% target share last 10 games; 25+ touches in 3/4 recent. Overreaction to injury scare fading.
items.why: Near-max utilization under Kubiak + consistent receiving role.
items.implication: Strong RB1/2 start; trust the volume.

items.text: LOVEs: Bucky Irving (career-high 26% tgt share, all RB RZ touches, out-routed Gainwell by 8 vs CLE); Dak Prescott (home smash vs WAS, high total); DeVonta Smith (27% tgt/13.7 aDOT vs TEN soft secondary); Justin Jefferson (37% tgt from Wentz, strong history); Dalton Kincaid (69% routes career-high, 77% snaps).
items.why: Week 1 usage spikes + matchup edges (e.g., DET allowed big TE production; TEN soft vs WR).
items.implication: Prioritize these in lineups; Kincaid breakout signal if healthy role sticks.
items.opportunity: Confirmed elevated routes/targets/snaps/RZ for Irving/Kincaid; volume for others.

items.text: HATEs: Travis Etienne (@BAL, committee with Miller + Kamara return squeezes role, underdog script); Marvin Harrison Jr. (8% tgt share Week 1, 0 RZ, tough SEA); Brian Thomas Jr. (@DEN tough perimeter/deep D + shoulder limited); Harold Fannin (14% tgt lowest since W5 last year, low aDOT, more competition).
items.why: Negative usage trends + tough matchups + injury/role competition.
items.implication: Fade/sit these; look elsewhere for flex.
items.opportunity: Etienne further capped by Kamara; Fannin target competition rising.

items.text: Week 2 waiver beneficiaries from injuries: Ladd McConkey=Tre Harris; Ja'Kobi Lane=Rashod Bateman/Chris Moore; AJ Brown=Romeo Doubs/DeMario Douglas; Alvin Kamara=Kendre Miller; plus others like Jordyn Tyson=Devaughn Vele. Streaming and precise role notes live.
items.why: Direct injury replacements with clear opportunity mapping.
items.implication: Priority adds in impacted backfields/WR rooms.
items.opportunity: Immediate snap/target inheritance for listed backups.
